scope: Ordinary production deployment component only. Excludes desktop template adapter, inference banks, full-turn gameplay and hardware qualification.

banked_fixture.scope: Real production setup gateway, bank24 payload, software/hardware stack balance and bottom-canary integrity, board serialization and RNG only. No full AI turn/source-template inference qualification.
banked_fixture.timing: Emulator CPU-cycle deltas include gateway and possible interrupts, not hardware latency or isolated instruction counts.
banked_fixture.stack_limit: A 16-byte bottom canary does not measure complete stack high-water usage.

limitations: No production installation or artwork regeneration.
Three PRG and RAM-bank binaries; not system ROM images.
Software/hardware stack balance and a bottom canary are tested, not full stack high-water/hardware timing.
A deployment component link does not qualify the full template-inference policy on CX16.
